assay: bulk RNA-seq (SMARTer Ultra Low Input, HiSeq 2000) of FACS-isolated quiescent MuSCs, one mouse per profile (S1.19.p1, FIG11 a)

ccnd1: KO (separate young Ccnd1 genotype experiment, S0.p15)

sample_inclusion: Exercise experiment: Y(-Ex), Y(+Ex), O(-Ex), O(+Ex) quiescent MuSCs (S0.p7, FIG11). The Ccnd1 genotype series (Y(WT)/Y(HET)/Y(KO)/O(WT), S0.p15) is a separate experiment and not an exercise estimand.
primary_estimand: Effect of voluntary wheel running on the quiescent MuSC transcriptome in old mice: O(+Ex) vs O(-Ex) (S0.p7, S0.p9, FIG11 c)
planned_contrasts: O(+Ex) vs O(-Ex) (S0.p7; paper: 248 DEGs at 10% FDR; Ccnd1 top hit, up with exercise, S0.p9)
Y(+Ex) vs Y(-Ex) (S0.p7; paper: 35 DEGs at 10% FDR)
O(-Ex) vs Y(-Ex) aging reference used to call 130 of the 248 genes 'rejuvenated' (S0.p7; count not reported)
repeated_measure_unit: none; each profile is an individual mouse (FIG11 a)
normalization: genes lacking Entrez ID or raw FPKM >= 1.5 in >= 3 samples removed (11,337 genes); raw counts normalized with RUVs k=6 for library prep and sample collection batch (S1.19.p3)
paper_method: edgeR negative binomial GLM likelihood ratio test, Cox-Reid tagwise dispersion, on RUVs-normalized raw counts, genes with normalized FPKM >= 6 in >= 3 samples; BH q-values (S1.19.p3)

named_genes: Ccnd1 (top hit, increased by exercise in old MuSCs)

paper_enrichment: GSEA Hallmark, Signal2Noise ranking, gene permutation (S1.19.p3, S0.p8, FIG5 b)
